brief.headline: Ask for ₹66.48/KG — the best price we already pay Sayaji — and save ₹1.26 Cr a year.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match ₹66.48/KG, the price Sayaji Industries gives us for the same Dextrose.
priceAsk.basis: We're paying them ₹68.45/KG today — 3.0% more than the ₹66.48/KG Sayaji charges. The market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP sits in the ₹60–81/kg band (typical ₹66–73/kg), so ₹66.48/KG is well inside market range and fair. The export reference line is even lower at 42.95 ₹/kg.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 days; no change needed.

brief.financialLeverage: They're a big, solid company — ₹5995.63 Cr in sales, they keep 8.5% as profit, and only 0.13x debt. We're 0.35% of their revenue, so we're a small customer to them. That said, they have plenty of room on price: keeping 8.5% out of every ₹100 they sell means a 3.0% price cut won't hurt them. The leverage is in the market: we already pay ₹66.48/KG elsewhere, and we can line up three more producers. They'll want to keep the business, but we need a second source anyway because 56% of our Dextrose (₹21.21 Cr) comes from them alone — too concentrated.

evidence.point: We pay them 3.0% more than our best price
Sayaji Industries sells us the same item at ₹66.48/KG
They keep a comfortable 8.5% of sales as profit
We're only 0.35% of their ₹5995.63 Cr revenue
Market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹66–73/kg typical, ₹60–81/kg band

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health score B (62/100) — a proven dextrose supplier and a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja.

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (starch, dextrose), ₹821.13 Cr revenue, health C (53/100) — growing capacity, credible second source.

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller, makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; confirm IP monograph CoA before switching. Revenue ₹365.39 Cr, health D (27/100).

risks: They supply 56% of our Dextrose (₹21.21 Cr) — we're too dependent on one source. Qualify a second supplier now, or a supply hiccup will hurt us.
We're a tiny 0.35% of their ₹5995.63 Cr revenue — they won't bend much on price unless we show them we have other options lined up.
Pushing too hard without a qualified backup could leave us scrambling if they walk; get Gulshan or Sanstar audited and priced before the meeting.
Their health score is only C (55/100) — not distressed, but not top-tier either. Watch for any sudden supply or quality issues.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to discuss bringing your Dextrose price in line with the ₹66.48/KG we're already paying Sayaji — and we're also qualifying a second source to balance our supply.
